description: One room and a cage. A counter runs under the armoured glass with the pad on the other side of it, a board of plates wanted and plates cleared, a kettle, a gun rack with a padlocked bar, and in the back corner a holding cage with a bench in it and nobody in it yet.

window.description: A slot of armoured glass at cab height looking straight onto the search pad. The officer on the counter can read a plate through it without standing up.
window.name: the armoured glass

name: South Gate Police Post
